rule_metadata.author: Saksham Bhattarai, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rule_metadata.title: Microsoft Office Application Loading Task Scheduler DLL

rules.rule_text:
title: Microsoft Office Application Loading Task Scheduler DLL
id: 8d1e674c-5c03-4be1-949c-4b85a472dc16
status: experimental
description: 'Detects a Microsoft Office application loading taskschd.dll, which exposes
  COM interfaces for managing Windows Scheduled Tasks.

  This load is an early precursor to scheduled task creation or modification and has
  been frequently observed in macro-enabled

  malicious documents attempting to establish persistence.

  '
references:
- https://github.com/saksham-17/detection-lab/blob/cbc25dfe1e5eda0c4e5a7d66b6d3bbd27829e158/T1053.005-scheduled-task/tests/test5-task-scheduler-via-VBA/report.md
author: Saksham Bhattarai, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
date: 2026-11-04
tags:
- attack.persistence
- attack.privilege-escalation
- attack.t1053.005
- attack.execution
- attack.t1204.002
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_dll:
  - ImageLoaded|endswith: \taskschd.dll
  - OriginalFileName: taskschd.dll
  selection_exe:
    Image|endswith:
    - \eqnedt32.exe
    - \excel.exe
    - \fltldr.exe
    - \graph.exe
    - \msaccess.exe
    - \mspub.exe
    - \onenote.exe
    - \onenoteim.exe
    - \onenotem.exe
    - \outlook.exe
    - \powerpnt.exe
    - \visio.exe
    - \winproj.exe
    - \winword.exe
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate add-ins or automation scripts that use Office applications to manage
  scheduled tasks (rare in most environments)
level: medium
regression_tests_path: regression_data/rules/windows/image_load/image_load_office_taskschd_dll_load/info.yml
